title: Reject .waystation/ changes committed on feature branches
description: README and ADR-0003 say feature branches must not commit or merge their checkout-local .waystation/ snapshot, but nothing enforces it. Add an enforcement point (pre-commit hook and/or CI check, optionally a validate diagnostic) that flags .waystation/** changes on branches other than the coordination branch, so stray branch-local ledger writes cannot silently diverge or be merged over the shared ledger's history.
acceptance: A commit on a non-coordination branch that touches .waystation/** is rejected or flagged with an actionable message naming the shared ledger root.
Commits from the coordination checkout are unaffected.
The check is documented in README alongside the shared-ledger instructions.
notes:
Decide whether the coordination branch name comes from config.json or defaults to main. Builds on the git.ledger_root setting from task-shared-ledger-main-worktree.

2026-10-10: Waystation now declares git.ledger_root=main_worktree (commit 119c8f3). Worktrees created before that commit keep using their branch-local ledger copy until they merge main: C:/Projects/Waystation-wt/{w01-persistence,w02-git-context,w03-parser-registry,search-performance-66790a} and the three C:/Users/User/.codex/worktrees checkouts. Waystation-wt/w01..w03 also hold untracked AGENT-BRIEF.md files, and w02 an untracked src/core/gitSource.ts + test/git-source.test.ts that differ from main's merged versions.
